description: Opaque floor-length navy blue court gown with cream under-skirt panel, gold geometric embroidery along low square neckline, shoulder straps, bodice, belt and hems. Both outer gown sleeves end at the elbows with soft brown fur edging. Blue-grey gold-bordered fringed shawl drapes around the forearms independently of sleeves. Plain round brooches at the shoulder straps, tied patterned belt at waist, complete brown leather shoes below the hem. Both hands rest clearly in front and the face is uncovered. Background is plain softly blurred stone columns and simple dark wooden doorway, no banner or heraldic wall hanging.
